notes: Flagged unit millebad (mi + le + bad → Besides) accounted morpheme by morpheme exactly as at v. 23: the separative מִן, the linking לְ and the lexeme-bearing בַּד are all carried by the one English word, so the grouping is indivisible under rule 30 and heads on בַּד.
The them of ye shall offer them answers to no object morpheme and is added under rule 44, as at v. 8.
without blemish is reordered after the copular clause, so its unit is discontinuous under rule 25.
